Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 07 December 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Laguna(San Pablo, Alaminos, Cavinti, Majayjay, Famy, Paete, Lumban, Santa Maria, Mabitac, Pakil, Pangil, Siniloan, Kalayaan, Luisiana, Pagsanjan, Magdalena, Santa Cruz, Pila, Victoria, Calauan, Bay, Los Banos, Nagcarlan, Liliw, Rizal) and Rizal(Tanay, Jala-Jala, Pililla).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas and Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Bocaue, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Santa Maria, Norzagaray, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Bulakan) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal(Cardona, Binangonan, Teresa, Morong, Antipolo, Baras, Angono) and Laguna(Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.text:
On this day in 1943, The Battleship USS Wisconsin was launched at the Philadelphia Naval Shipyard.  How the ship earned the nickname, “Big Wisky”, will surprise you. This Iowa-class battleship fought fiercely during World War II, where she participated in the Philippines campaign, the battles of Iwo Jima and Okinawa, and the bombardment of Japan. Her service continued throughout the Korean War and even against Iraq during the Gulf War in 1991, where Big Wisky was America’s last battleship to fire its guns in combat. How did she earn the name, “Big Wisky”?  On May 6, 1956, Wisconsin collided with the Destroyer USS Eaton in heavy fog. With extensive damage to her bow section, the battleship sailed to Norfolk Naval Shipyard for repairs. A replacement bow was taken from the incomplete battleship USS Kentucky and installed onto Wisconsin in only a matter of days.  Taking the name Wisconsin and adding “KY”, created the nickname “Wisky”. You can still visit “Big Wisky” today.  She serves as a museum and historical landmark in Norfolk, Virginia.
.
